vars.task: Read-only first owned-root smoke. Verify the assigned root's path, branch, pinned HEAD, and clean source state. Make no source edits and no source commit. Produce the two required ORCA report artifacts with status blocked if any precondition fails. Do not launch another agent.
vars.scope: The ORCA-assigned execution directory and its Git metadata, plus only the required .orca/reports deliverables. Do not inspect other checkouts, stores, credentials, services, or runs.
vars.tests: Use only pwd -P, git rev-parse --show-toplevel, git rev-parse HEAD, git symbolic-ref --short HEAD, and git status --porcelain=v1 in the assigned directory. Compare the results with the recorded workspace cwd/branch and expectedHead. Do not run Node, pnpm, builds, package tests, dependency installs, network commands, or service probes. Record exact commands/results in the report.
